cards.english_title: Rehabilitation sites finally get money and sand
cards.korean_desc: PWD가 케랄라 세 터에 2억6800만 루피를 받았습니다. 돈은 준설 모래를 옮겨 습지를 보강합니다. 코친항은 모래 52,958.70세제곱미터를 무료로 풀었습니다. 입찰 뒤 공사가 시작되고 코치 메트로가 효과를 감독합니다.
cards.english_desc: PWD received ₹2.68 crore to strengthen three rehabilitation sites in Kerala. The money will transport dredged sand and reinforce marshy ground. Cochin Port Authority released 52,958.70 cubic metres of sand free. Work starts after tendering, while Kochi Metro will supervise effectiveness.
cards.hook: Three sites will finally become buildable.
cards.takeaway_english: The money solves a land problem, but families still need the promised rehabilitation to finish.
cards.takeaway_korean: 돈은 땅 문제를 풀지만 재정착은 아직 끝나지 않았습니다.

why_it_matters.english: Families need stable land before they can construct homes.
why_it_matters.korean: 가족들은 집을 지을 튼튼한 땅이 필요합니다.

why_it_matters.english: The project shows how infrastructure displacement can create long rehabilitation delays.
why_it_matters.korean: 개발 이주가 긴 재정착 지연을 만들 수 있습니다.

parties.label: PWD
parties.english: It will coordinate and carry out the site-strengthening work.

parties.label: Evicted families
parties.english: They may finally build homes on their allocated rehabilitation land.

parties.label: Cochin Port Authority
parties.english: It provided dredged sand without charge for the work.

views.label: Moolamppilly Coordination Committee
views.english: The funding is a proactive step toward resolving a long-delayed rehabilitation problem.
views.korean: 위원회는 이번 지원을 적극적 조치로 봅니다.

views.label: District administration
views.english: The plan focuses on strengthening land first, before construction can begin.
views.korean: 행정은 먼저 땅을 단단하게 하려 합니다.

disagree.english: Families may still worry because construction starts only after tendering and earlier promises remain unresolved.
disagree.korean: 입찰 전에는 공사가 시작되지 않아 걱정할 수 있습니다.

cards.english_title: Microsoft restores services after a global outage
cards.korean_desc: 마이크로소프트는 2026년 11월 14일 팀즈와 아웃룩을 복구했습니다. 장애는 전 세계 이메일과 일정과 업무 소통을 막았습니다. 마이크로소프트는 수정하고 트래픽을 돌리고 서버를 늘렸습니다. 마이크로소프트는 지연 메일과 추가 문제를 감시합니다.
cards.english_desc: Microsoft restored Teams, Outlook, Copilot and other services on November 14, 2026. The disruption blocked email, calendars and workplace communication worldwide. Microsoft tested fixes, rerouted traffic and expanded server capacity. Microsoft is monitoring delayed email and possible further problems.
cards.hook: Microsoft services are back after a daylong breakdown.
cards.takeaway_english: Services returned, but the outage left a warning about concentrated digital infrastructure.
cards.takeaway_korean: 서비스는 돌아왔지만 집중된 디지털 인프라에 경고를 남겼습니다.

why_it_matters.english: Email and workplace tools support everyday business and public services.
why_it_matters.korean: 이메일과 업무 도구는 기업과 공공서비스를 움직입니다.

why_it_matters.english: A single provider failure can affect many unrelated organizations together.
why_it_matters.korean: 한 업체 장애가 여러 기관을 동시에 멈출 수 있습니다.

parties.label: Microsoft
parties.english: It restored affected services and is monitoring delayed email.
parties.korean: 마이크로소프트는 서비스를 복구하고 지연 메일을 감시합니다.

parties.label: Businesses and governments
parties.english: They lost access to email, calendars and workplace communication.
parties.korean: 기업과 정부는 이메일과 업무 소통을 잃었습니다.

parties.label: Customers
parties.english: They may still receive delayed messages from the outage period.
parties.korean: 고객들은 장애 중 지연된 메시지를 받을 수 있습니다.

views.label: Microsoft
views.english: The company says the underlying issue was addressed and no cyberattack caused the outage.
views.korean: 회사는 근본 문제가 해결됐고 사이버공격은 아니라고 말합니다.

views.label: Technology experts
views.english: They say the disruption shows the risk of depending on a few large providers.
views.korean: 전문가들은 소수 대형 업체 의존의 위험을 말합니다.

disagree.english: Some customers may argue that recovery is not enough without clearer technical details and stronger backup systems.
disagree.korean: 고객들은 자세한 설명과 더 강한 백업이 필요하다고 할 수 있습니다.

cards.english_title: The Singh Twins turn miniature art into history
cards.korean_desc: 암리트와 라빈드라 싱은 뉴델리에서 디지털 작품을 전시합니다. 그들의 이미지는 영국 제국 역사의 기억을 묻습니다. 자매는 미니어처에 인물과 상징과 디지털 콜라주를 겹칩니다. 그들의 작품은 공공 소장과 미술 교육으로 계속 들어갑니다.
cards.english_desc: Amrit and Rabindra Singh are showing digital mixed-media works in New Delhi. Their images question how British imperial history is remembered. They layer miniature painting with historical figures, symbols and digital collage. Their work continues to enter public collections and art education.
cards.hook: Miniature art becomes a sharp colonial history lesson.
cards.takeaway_english: The twins use beauty as an entrance, then make history impossible to ignore.
cards.takeaway_korean: 자매는 아름다움으로 시작해 역사를 외면하지 못하게 합니다.

why_it_matters.english: The works connect colonial history with present questions about identity and migration.
why_it_matters.korean: 작품은 식민 역사와 정체성 및 이주 문제를 잇습니다.

why_it_matters.english: They challenge the idea that serious art must look plain or solemn.
why_it_matters.korean: 진지한 미술은 평범해야 한다는 생각에 도전합니다.

parties.label: The Singh Twins
parties.english: They combine Indian miniature traditions, digital collage and political criticism.
parties.korean: 싱 자매는 인도 미니어처와 디지털 콜라주를 결합합니다.

parties.label: Sunaina Anand
parties.english: She presents their work in Art Alive’s anniversary exhibition.
parties.korean: 수나이나 아난드는 기념 전시에 작품을 소개합니다.

parties.label: Delhi viewers
parties.english: They encounter visual arguments about colonialism and diaspora identity.
parties.korean: 델리 관객은 식민주의와 디아스포라 정체성을 만납니다.

views.label: The Singh Twins
views.english: Their decorative surfaces invite viewers before confronting them with colonial violence and inequality.
views.korean: 화려한 표면 뒤에 식민 폭력과 불평등을 보여줍니다.

views.label: Early critics
views.english: Some first dismissed the style as decorative folk art or commercial kitsch.
views.korean: 초기 비평가들은 작품을 장식적 민속미술로 낮춰 보았습니다.

disagree.english: Viewers may value the political message but still find the dense symbolism difficult to read.
disagree.korean: 관객은 정치적 뜻을 좋아해도 상징을 어렵게 느낄 수 있습니다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 아름다운 미술은 어려운 역사를 쉽게 보여줄까요?

caption_lines: The exhibition marked Art Alive Gallery’s 25th anniversary.

cards.reader_question: Can beautiful art make difficult history easier to face?

cards.english_title: Siniakova claims a record sixth doubles crown
cards.korean_desc: 카테리나 시니아코바가 2026년 WTA 복식 1위로 끝냈습니다. 그녀는 54승 8패와 복식 우승 7개를 기록했습니다. 테일러 타운센드와 5개, 장솨이와 2개를 우승했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Katerina Siniakova finished 2026 as the WTA’s top-ranked doubles player. She posted a 54-8 record and won seven doubles titles. Five titles came with Taylor Townsend and two came with Zhang Shuai.
cards.hook: Six year-end No. 1 finishes now belong to Siniakova.
cards.takeaway_english: Siniakova’s record rests on both elite ranking time and a remarkably strong 2026 season.
cards.takeaway_korean: 시니아코바의 기록은 긴 1위 기간과 강한 2026시즌에 바탕을 둡니다.

why_it_matters.english: Her results show how doubles careers are built through different partnerships.
why_it_matters.korean: 그녀의 성적은 여러 파트너로 복식 경력을 쌓는 방식을 보여줍니다.

why_it_matters.english: The record gives women’s doubles a clear historical milestone.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 기록은 여자 복식의 분명한 역사적 이정표입니다.

parties.label: Katerina Siniakova
parties.english: She finished 2026 as the WTA’s top-ranked doubles player.

parties.label: Taylor Townsend
parties.english: She partnered Siniakova for five titles and the WTA Finals.

parties.label: Martina Navratilova
parties.english: She still leads the all-time weeks-at-No. 1 list.
parties.korean: 마르티나 나브라틸로바는 누적 1위 기간이 더 깁니다.

views.label: WTA
views.english: The organization calls Siniakova’s season historic and exceptionally consistent.
views.korean: WTA는 시니아코바의 시즌을 역사적이고 꾸준했다고 평가합니다.

views.label: Siniakova
views.english: She credits hard work, dedication and consistency behind every season.

disagree.english: Some fans may value Grand Slam wins more than rankings or the number of weeks at No. 1.
disagree.korean: 일부 팬은 순위보다 그랜드슬램 우승을 더 중요하게 볼 수 있습니다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 복식에서는 우승과 장기 순위 중 무엇이 중요할까요?

cards.english_title: Hombale announces an AI-assisted Prabhupada biopic
cards.korean_desc: 홈발레 필름스가 이스콘 창립자 프라부파다 영화 사라나가티를 발표했습니다. 전기 영화는 그의 인도에서 미국까지 영적 여정을 따릅니다. 제작진은 인공지능 모션 캡처를 사용합니다. 영화는 2027년 8월 전 세계 극장에서 개봉합니다.
cards.english_desc: Hombale Films announced Saranagati, a film about ISKCON founder Śrīla Prabhupāda. The biopic follows his spiritual mission from India to America. The production will use Artificial Intelligence Motion Capture. The film is scheduled for worldwide theatrical release in August 2027.
cards.hook: A new film will bring Prabhupada’s journey to cinemas.
cards.korean_hook: 새 영화가 프라부파다의 여정을 극장에 보여줍니다.
cards.takeaway_english: The project’s real test will be balancing devotion, history and technological spectacle.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이 영화의 시험은 신앙과 역사와 기술을 균형 있게 보여주는 일입니다.

why_it_matters.english: The film joins religious storytelling with new production technology.
why_it_matters.korean: 영화는 종교 이야기와 새 제작 기술을 결합합니다.

why_it_matters.english: It could introduce ISKCON’s founder to audiences unfamiliar with his history.
why_it_matters.korean: 프라부파다의 역사를 모르는 관객에게 그를 소개할 수 있습니다.

parties.label: Hombale Films
parties.english: It is producing the film with Transcendental Films.
parties.korean: 홈발레 필름스는 트랜센덴털 필름스와 영화를 만듭니다.

parties.label: Gaura Shakti Dasa
parties.english: He directs the film and writes its story.
parties.korean: 가우라 샥티 다사는 영화를 연출하고 씁니다.

parties.label: ISKCON followers
parties.english: They may see a cinematic account of their founder’s life.
parties.korean: 이스콘 신자들은 창립자의 삶을 영화로 보게 됩니다.

views.label: Film makers
views.english: They present modern technology as a way to bring spiritual history to wider audiences.
views.korean: 제작진은 현대 기술로 영적 역사를 널리 전하려 합니다.

views.label: Critical viewers
views.english: They may want the film to distinguish devotional interpretation from historical evidence.
views.korean: 비판적 관객은 신앙 해석과 역사적 증거를 구분하길 바랄 수 있습니다.

disagree.english: Some viewers may welcome the project, while others may question AI motion capture in a religious biography.
disagree.korean: 일부 관객은 환영하지만 AI 모션 캡처를 의문시할 수 있습니다.

cards.reader_question_korean: AI 기술로 만든 영적 전기를 보겠습니까?

cards.english_title: India backs a UN resolution on Palestinian resource rights
cards.korean_desc: 인도를 포함해 151개국이 결의안에 찬성했습니다. 7개국은 반대했고 11개국은 기권했습니다. 결의안은 자원 착취와 기반시설 파괴의 중단을 요구합니다.
cards.english_desc: The vote passed with 151 countries supporting it, including India. Seven countries opposed it and eleven abstained. The resolution demands an end to damage, exploitation and destruction of vital infrastructure.
cards.hook: India backed Palestinian resource rights at the UN.
cards.takeaway_english: The vote adds diplomatic pressure, but its practical effect remains uncertain.
cards.takeaway_korean: 표결은 외교적 압력을 더하지만 실제 효과는 불확실합니다.

why_it_matters.english: The resolution links political control with access to land, water and electricity.
why_it_matters.korean: 결의안은 정치적 지배와 땅과 물과 전기 접근을 연결합니다.

why_it_matters.english: Its vote shows strong support but also clear disagreement among powerful states.
why_it_matters.korean: 표결은 큰 지지와 강대국 사이의 분명한 반대를 함께 보여줍니다.

parties.label: India
parties.english: It voted for the resolution alongside 150 other UN members.

parties.label: Israel and the United States
parties.english: They voted against the draft resolution.

parties.label: Palestinian people
parties.english: The resolution reaffirms their rights over land, water and energy resources.
parties.korean: 결의안은 땅과 물과 에너지 권리를 재확인합니다.

views.label: UN and supporting states
views.english: They say the resolution protects Palestinian and Syrian resource rights under international law.
views.korean: 유엔과 지지국은 국제법이 자원권을 보호한다고 말합니다.

views.label: Israel and the United States
views.english: They opposed the draft, showing that the resolution lacks universal agreement.
views.korean: 이스라엘과 미국은 반대해 보편적 합의가 없음을 보였습니다.

disagree.english: Opponents may argue that a General Assembly resolution cannot by itself settle the conflict or enforce its demands.
disagree.korean: 반대자들은 총회 결의만으로 분쟁을 해결하거나 요구를 집행할 수 없다고 말할 수 있습니다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 국제 결의는 지지 표현 외에 무엇을 해야 할까요?
cards.source_title: India supports UNGA resolution on permanent sovereignty of Palestinian people
caption_lines: The vote took place on November 11, 2026.
The resolution was proposed by Uruguay.
It also covered the occupied Syrian Golan.
cards.reader_question: What should international resolutions do beyond expressing support?

sources.title: India supports UNGA resolution on permanent sovereignty of Palestinian people

sentences.english: The vote passed with 151 countries supporting it, including India.
sentences.korean: 인도를 포함해 151개국이 결의안에 찬성했습니다.

sentences.english: Seven countries opposed it and eleven abstained.
sentences.korean: 7개국은 반대했고 11개국은 기권했습니다.

sentences.english: The resolution demands an end to damage, exploitation and destruction of vital infrastructure.
